invariants.rationale: The method requires the XML root element; it's expected to be non-null as a precondition.
The method operates on the file handle; it is expected to be non-null as a reasonable precondition.
The method uses imageResolver parameter to resolve tile textures, so it must not be null.
A tiled map should have at least a TileSheets section in its root, so it's reasonable to expect this child element exists.
A tiled map should have a Layers section in its root; this is needed for loading layers.
